text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D and E after gains felt good, but buying them back later reminds me to trim only when it fits a portfolio plan—not just to lock in gains.","I bought more of every stock, then watched the account decline; I should check that each purchase and my overall stock exposure fit my risk tolerance and cash needs.","A few losing months are not enough reason to react impulsively. Since I check infrequently, I should follow a diversified long-term plan and review it at set intervals."]}
